title: SkyrimNet Trigger
description: A YAML rule that watches for a game event and emits a response (dialogue, narration, thought, diary entry, virtual NPC or voice effect change). Shape matches SkyrimNet's WORKFLOW_TRIGGERS.md and Config/TriggerConfig.h. This schema is descriptive only: the hub validator parses trigger YAML and checks name == filename stem (case-insensitively) but does not apply this schema; semantic validation (real eventType names, valid schemaCondition field paths for the declared eventType) runs inside the dashboard via SkyrimNet's own validate_custom_trigger at publish time.

name.description: Identifier for this trigger. The hub validator requires it to equal the filename stem, compared case-insensitively; SkyrimNet itself accepts any string. snake_case is the convention.

description.description: Human-readable description of when this trigger fires and what it does.

eventCriteria.description: One rule object, or a list of rule objects that are OR-ed (the trigger fires when any rule matches).

eventType.description: Game event type. Values SkyrimNet registers: spell_cast, active_effect, hit, combat, death, crime, dragon_soul, equip, enter_bleedout, activation, sleep_start, sleep_stop, book_read, container_changed, trade_start, trade_complete, lock_changed, quest_stage, quest_start_stop, quest_objective_state, cell_attach_detach, location_change, scene, scene_action, scene_phase, package_apply, package_remove, custom, direct_narration, continue_narration, persistent_generic, gamemaster_dialogue, mod_event, animation_event, diary_entry_created, messagebox, notification, dialogue, dialogue_npc, dialogue_player, dialogue_player_stt, dialogue_player_text, dialogue_player_telepathy, dialogue_npc_telepathy, dialogue_background, player_thoughts, npc_thoughts, dialogue_player_monologue, or '*' for wildcard. SkyrimNet may add more; this field is not an enum for forward compatibility. Real validity is checked by validate_custom_trigger at publish time.

schemaConditions.description: Filters on the event's extraData fields, combined with logicalOperator (default AND).

fieldPath.description: Dot-path into the event's extraData (e.g. 'event_name', 'sender_form_id', 'num_arg'). Available paths vary by eventType.

operator.description: Comparison operator, exactly as SkyrimNet's TriggerManager spells it. equals/not_equals work on any type; contains/not_contains on strings (substring) and arrays (element); starts_with, ends_with and regex on strings; greater_than, greater_equal, less_than and less_equal on numbers; length_* on arrays; has_field/not_has_field on objects. There is no matches_regex, greater_than_or_equal or less_than_or_equal: an unknown operator never matches.

value.description: Scalar value to compare against. Inja template strings like '{{ player_name }}' are allowed.

logicalOperator.description: How this rule's schemaConditions combine. Default: AND. Uppercase only.

eventType.description: Game event type. Values SkyrimNet registers: spell_cast, active_effect, hit, combat, death, crime, dragon_soul, equip, enter_bleedout, activation, sleep_start, sleep_stop, book_read, container_changed, trade_start, trade_complete, lock_changed, quest_stage, quest_start_stop, quest_objective_state, cell_attach_detach, location_change, scene, scene_action, scene_phase, package_apply, package_remove, custom, direct_narration, continue_narration, persistent_generic, gamemaster_dialogue, mod_event, animation_event, diary_entry_created, messagebox, notification, dialogue, dialogue_npc, dialogue_player, dialogue_player_stt, dialogue_player_text, dialogue_player_telepathy, dialogue_npc_telepathy, dialogue_background, player_thoughts, npc_thoughts, dialogue_player_monologue, or '*' for wildcard. SkyrimNet may add more; this field is not an enum for forward compatibility. Real validity is checked by validate_custom_trigger at publish time.

schemaConditions.description: Filters on the event's extraData fields, combined with logicalOperator (default AND).

fieldPath.description: Dot-path into the event's extraData (e.g. 'event_name', 'sender_form_id', 'num_arg'). Available paths vary by eventType.

operator.description: Comparison operator, exactly as SkyrimNet's TriggerManager spells it. equals/not_equals work on any type; contains/not_contains on strings (substring) and arrays (element); starts_with, ends_with and regex on strings; greater_than, greater_equal, less_than and less_equal on numbers; length_* on arrays; has_field/not_has_field on objects. There is no matches_regex, greater_than_or_equal or less_than_or_equal: an unknown operator never matches.

value.description: Scalar value to compare against. Inja template strings like '{{ player_name }}' are allowed.

logicalOperator.description: How this rule's schemaConditions combine. Default: AND. Uppercase only.

type.description: Kind of response generated when the trigger matches. player_thought = player internal monologue, player_dialogue = player speaks aloud, npc_thought = unvoiced thought for the target NPC(s), direct_narration = narrative text NPCs react to, persistent_generic = log event without dialogue, diary_entry = create a diary entry, dynamic_bio_update = update character biography, enable_virtual_npc / disable_virtual_npc = toggle a virtual NPC named by targetName, activate_voice_effect / deactivate_voice_effect = set or clear a voice effect recipe on the target actor(s).

content.description: Inja template string. Variables set per event by SkyrimNet's TriggerManager: {{ originator }} (display name of the event's originating actor), {{ originator_uuid }}, {{ target }}, {{ target_uuid }}, {{ actor.name }} / {{ actor.UUID }} (originator as an object), {{ target_actor.name }} / {{ target_actor.UUID }}, {{ player.name }} / {{ player.UUID }}, {{ event_json.FIELD }} (any extraData field of the event), {{ event_type }}, {{ event_location }}, {{ timestamp }}; plus the prompt engine's defaults such as {{ player_name }}, {{ location }}, {{ gameTime }} and every decorator (e.g. {{ decnpc(originator_uuid).possessivePronoun }}). Which actor is the originator depends on the event: for active_effect it is the actor the effect was applied to (event_json.target) and target is the caster; for hit the aggressor; for death the victim; for dialogue the speaker. An unknown variable is a render error: the engine logs it and posts the template text verbatim. Not required for enable_virtual_npc, disable_virtual_npc, activate_voice_effect or deactivate_voice_effect.

targetScope.description: Who the response applies to for diary_entry, dynamic_bio_update, npc_thought, activate_voice_effect and deactivate_voice_effect. Default: triggering_actor.

nearbyRadius.description: Optional. Radius in game units for all_nearby_actors (default 2000).

targetName.description: enable_virtual_npc / disable_virtual_npc: name of the virtual NPC to toggle. Inja templates allowed (e.g. '{{ originator }}').

effectId.description: activate_voice_effect: id of the voice effect recipe to apply (e.g. 'werewolf').

promptTemplate.description: Optional prompt template override used by the generating response types.

audience.description: Who perceives the response. Default: player. originator = actor that caused the event, target = target of the event, nearby_npcs = NPCs only (excludes player), enabled_virtual_npcs = every enabled virtual NPC.

enabled.description: If false, the trigger is skipped entirely. Default: true.

probability.description: Chance per matching event that the response actually fires (0.0 to 1.0). Default: 1.0.

cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between fires for this trigger. Default: 0.

priority.description: Ordering hint when multiple triggers match the same event. Higher fires first.

interrupt.description: If true, queued dialogue and audio are purged before the response runs. Default: false.
